knownLimits: Current bridge and culvert elevations unknown; no structure openings
Published CN antecedent assumption (GCN10 fair ARCII undrained); no measured transmission loss

Terrain is bare-earth lidar: 1 m PimaCounty_2021_B21 and Eastern_PimaCO_2015 in road/wash windows (2015 covers most of the mid/upper Brawley mainstem and San Joaquin/Black Wash); 10 m context mixes all-route-context-v2, 2021, BrawleyRillito 2018 (flown 2019), 2015 and 0.98 km2 of USGS 1/3 arc-second; not a 2026 survey
2021 minus 2015 seam offset about -0.11 m median in 7 road windows; not corrected
6.25 m computational cells are not validated road-depth accuracy; compare cell water-surface elevation zs with road height, never averaged depth
The 27.47 km2 local catchment of 15876941 below USGS 09487000 is excluded; its runoff enters only through the inlet series

Directed network independence does not prove no cross-divide overland exchange; overlaps Gates by 139.42 km2; west-valley subtrees drain toward Northern, which keeps its own NWM inlets (independent model)

Domain v2 (1240 km2) adds the west-valley subtrees of Northern inlets 15876639/653/641/623, Pump Station tributaries 15876613/15876627 and terminal subtrees 15876757/719/669/675; 19 candidate dips (6 >= 1 m, mostly W Silverbell Rd and N Red Hill Rd near 32.445 N) remain in no model
Road heights exist only inside the floodplain-road-heights-v1 tile box (about lon >= -111.44, lat >= 32.146); roads outside it have no comparison
Extended validation window: rain 14Z Nov 1..07Z Nov 2 is still the frozen HRRR forecast (as in the frozen case), only 07Z..18Z Nov 2 is observed Stage IV

terrainSources.road1m: USGS 3DEP 1 m windows .sfincs-runs/brawley-avra-west-terrain-1m-v1 (162 new + reused) plus -v2 top-up (146 new); PimaCounty_2021_B21 > BrawleyRillito_2018_D19 > Eastern_PimaCO_2015
terrainSources.context10m: .sfincs-runs/brawley-avra-west-context-v2 (16.97 km2 USGS 1/3 arc-second where no 1 m exists; no L3/L4 zone there)

scope.outflow: open outflows where the Brawley local set and the west-valley subtrees join water carried by the Northern case (HydroMT directed outflow points); terminal subtrees end inside the domain
scope.roadOwnership: owns every area-tile road station inside its domain that is more than 15 m from a rated route (rated-route stations stay with the route cases)
scope.limitation: Directed network independence does not prove no cross-divide overland exchange

inflow.gauge: USGS 09487000 Brawley Wash near Three Points (provisional IV 00060)
inflow.note: Validation variant: same mesh, parameters and boundaries as brawley-avra-west-native-case-v2; 75 hourly observed values (15-min reading at top of each hour x 0.0283168), 2026-10-30T16Z..2026-11-02T18Z. Not for live registration.

window.rain: Frozen v2 package frames 2026-10-30T16Z..2026-11-02T07Z unchanged (Stage IV/MRMS analysis to 14Z Nov 1, then HRRR 2026-11-01T14Z forecast 14Z..07Z), then observed Stage IV 01h (IEM) for 07Z..18Z Nov 2 on the same grid and mapping; no HRRR in the extension, no zero-fill
window.note: Validation-only extended window so the observed inflow wave can pass Manville, Tucker and the outlet. Not a live configuration and not tuned.
